stylePrefix: 90s American cable TV cartoon style, surreal funny food shapes, thick clean black ink outlines, flat cel animation colors, hand-drawn 2D animation look, warm appetizing dessert palette, polished Unity game dish sprite quality, funny, weird, charming, pure food only, no face, no eyes, no mouth, no limbs, no mascot treatment, no text, no logo, no watermark

typePromptPrefixes.dish: Dish sprite rule: board food sprite on a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF chroma key background. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation. Do not use #FF00FF anywhere in the food. No cast shadow, no contact shadow, no plate unless the dish requires a cup or glass vessel, no table, no utensils, no grid lines, no cell borders, no checkerboard.
